summary: Rebuilt the Source Data tab around a quiet surface with interactive column distribution previews.
details: The header omits the decorative state dot and shows the source file name with a borderless circled-exclamation details icon; its wider floating Source Table panel shows the folder path with an inline copy action, while Reload, Browse, full-path Copy, and Open folder remain grouped icon actions.
Row count, column count, file size, modified time, and cache freshness moved into a floating panel behind the info icon.

The date band uses Origin Period and Development End labels with clearer spacing and borderless calendar icons that open a left-aligned shared picker; its clickable year heading hides the navigation arrows while showing the selected year and preceding 50 years, and the picker remains available while the pointer is inside it.
The column list adds a filter, regular-weight first-column row text, resizable Column Name and Data Type columns, and a Distribution mark that fills the remaining width.

Hovering a Distribution cell opens a preview beside the pointer with separate filled and null percentages, actual-share-of-filled meters for ranked values, a histogram for numeric values, and samples; clicking the cell pins the preview until Escape or an outside click.
Table summaries now include per-column distribution, distinct, and null-value statistics; existing summary caches regenerate once on first read.
